gloss_en: the coming of the Messiah — the future eschatological arrival of Mashiach (יָבוֹא מָשִׁיחַ, 'Mashiach will come'), who, identified here with Moshe, will complete and fully erect the stature of the Shekhinah built up by the prayers of the tzaddikim of every generation; not any other sense of 'coming' or of the root משח (e.g., anointing oil or an anointed priest/king generally)
